title: M100 node power anomaly identification
query_text: A facility power alert fired for rack 10. Which node is drawing anomalous power and by how much?

eval_criteria.gold_answer: Node r10n4 is the power anomaly. Its ipmi total_power is sustained well above its rack-10 peer baseline — the other rack-10 nodes cluster at a much lower draw — exceeding the 1300W sustained per-node alert threshold for an extended period. The power-supply inputs ps0_input_power and ps1_input_power are both elevated in proportion, confirming real draw rather than a sensor fault. Correlate with job 7558120 (cfd_solver) and consider applying a per-node power cap.
